set.body: Outcome: an installable Python pilot with checked rich-account construction and analysis, legacy synthetic bundle compatibility, and a React inspector under port/. Add fast-but-correct port/AGENTS.md. Preserve exact evidence, explicit status/reference semantics, replay and inspection boundaries; improve design rather than translate classes. Use focused checks and record actual parity and remaining Stage 1 obligations. No Scala changes, external provider calls or study data access.
set.title: Implement Stage 1 executable Python and React foundation
